notes.title: Game Update: Evolving Metal Ape
notes.content:
Dear Players,

I'm excited to share a significant update on my game project! After thoughtful consideration and community feedback, Metal Ape is evolving into a more engaging and polished experience while maintaining its unique style and universe.

Drawing inspiration from iconic classics like Prince of Persia and Oddworld, Metal Ape's gameplay is transforming to deliver a better and more refined experience. This will allows me to focus on enhancing mechanics and storytelling,

While the metroidvania elements won't be part of the final game, I hope that you'll enjoy this new direction.

Get a sneak peek of what's to come in my latest trailer:

notes.title: Metal Ape Demo Release
notes.content:
Hey there, gaming community! I'm stoked to announce the release of the Metal Ape demo. This 2D souls-like metroidvania is a project close to my heart, and I can't wait for you to dive in.

The demo provides a glimpse into the full experience, featuring a powerful arsenal of abilities. Customize your playstyle, unlock skills, and indulge in the RPG aspect by crafting items to amplify your abilities.

I'm aware that there might be some bumps in the road when it comes to difficulty balancing and items. Your feedback is gold to me.  Let's make Metal Ape the best it can be!

Thanks a bunch! 🤘

notes.title: Watch the developer play
notes.content:
I am excited to announce that I will be hosting a live-stream broadcast of our game Metal Ape. Join us as we take you on an epic journey!

During the broadcast, you will get a first look at the gameplay mechanics we have developed so far.

I cannot wait to share our progress with you and get your feedback as we continue to develop Metal Ape.
